metadata.ffmpeg_version: 7.1-essentials_build-www.gyan.dev built with gcc 14.2.0 (Rev1, Built by MSYS2 project)

scan.note: Technical signals only. Continuous visual review and user approval remain separate.

review_method: All145 thumbnails,25 larger whole-frame samples,5 face samples; native A1 frames0/30/48 or A2 frame60. No continuous normal-speed assistant playback.
actual_motion: Small torso adjustment toward daylight and relaxed settle; hand initially on knee moves near bench. No full sitting-down action.
identity_wardrobe_background: Recognizable identity, plain tee/navy trousers, cream lapels and brown bag retained in sampled frames. Bench/window/wall broadly stable; exact pixel lock and every native hand-contact frame not certified.
